rule_text.name: 701.96a
rule_text.rule: Judge is a keyword action. To judge a permanent, honor it or condemn it. If you honor it, put a +1/+1 counter on it. If you condemn it, sacrifice it, then draw a card.

rule_text.name: 701.96b
rule_text.rule: Honoring or condemning a permanent has no rules meaning, and only acts a designation that spells and abilities can identify.
